ValidationRule.description: Prevent QF Rate Audit team from closing Non Freight Invoicing record type cases - CRM-8116
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( TEXT(Status) = 'Closed - Completed', TEXT(Status) = 'Closed - Rejected', TEXT(Status) = 'Closed' ), TEXT($User.Freight_Department__c) = 'Freight Audit')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to update the case.
